US Bull Market Nears Milestone Amid AI-Driven Profits

The US bull market is approaching a four-year milestone, propelled by investments in AI infrastructure that have fueled a 117% rally in the S&P 500. Despite this growth, market concentration in major tech companies, 10-year Treasury yields nearing 5.2%, and potential volatility from upcoming midterm elections present risks to the market's sustainability. A recent auction of 30-year Treasury bonds was described as 'solid,' with yields remaining steady.
